# `aitbc analytics alerts`

View performance alerts filtered by severity and time range.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc analytics alerts [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--severity` | choice | `all` | no | Alert severity filter |
| `--hours` | integer | `24` | no | Time range in hours |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc analytics alerts
```
